delta-engine.description: Perceptual delta token engine. Defines ΔL, ΔC, ΔH rules per interaction state in OKLCH space.

hue-family-resolution.circular-hue-rule: Use min(abs(a-b), 360-abs(a-b)) for all hue proximity checks.
hue-family-resolution.boundary-rule: H on exact boundary: assign to higher-indexed family. H=65° → yellow, not orange.

interaction-direction-multiplier.description: Global direction controller. Ensures hover/active/pressed cascade correctly on both dark fills and light containers.

below-threshold.description: Dark fills. Lighten on hover, darken on active/pressed.

above-threshold.description: Light containers. Darken on hover, darken more on active/pressed.

apca-delta-correction-policy.description: Corrects interaction state tokens that fail APCA contrast after delta application. Runs after state-delta-rules. Audit policy in apca-extensions-audit-policy runs before this.

reduce-\u0394Opacity.until: APCA target satisfied OR ΔOpacity reaches 1.0
reduce-\u0394Opacity.restriction-1: Non-text component states only. MUST NOT be applied to text-bearing states.
reduce-\u0394Opacity.restriction-2: MUST NOT be applied to surfaces containing text-bearing descendants. Opacity propagates to child text elements and silently alters their contrast ratios.
reduce-\u0394Opacity.compiler-instruction: Before applying: inspect component tree. If token is applied to a container role with text-bearing child roles (text-primary, text-secondary, on-* roles) in its scope, skip ΔOpacity and emit build warning.
reduce-\u0394Opacity.note: Last resort axis. Emit warning rather than skip silently.

apca-extensions-audit-policy.description: Defines how $extensions.org.design-system.apca is written, validated, and enforced at build time. Extends apca-delta-correction-policy — does not replace it. Audit runs FIRST. Correction policy activates only when a state token fails after delta application.
apca-extensions-audit-policy.dtcg-spec-reference: W3C Design Tokens Community Group — $extensions field

verified.note: Set false on any $value change. Reset to true only by audit tool.

on-hex-srgb.note: Resolved sRGB hex at audit time

lc.note: Actual Lc from calculator — not estimated

gamut.note: Both gamuts required for dual-variant tokens

block-on-fail.note: Fail build if any pair.status = fail

ui-label.applies-to: Button labels, nav items, form labels, badges

decorative.applies-to: Ornamental icons, disabled states — non-informational only

non-text.applies-to: UI component boundaries, focus rings — shape contrast not text

known-failures.description: Contrast pairs identified as failing or at-risk from audit. Must be resolved before shipping.

text-secondary-on-bg-primary.resolution: Move text/secondary source stop from 700 to 800 (#510D75). Estimated Lc ~68. Re-audit required.
text-secondary-on-bg-primary.resolution-applied: Stop moved from 700 to 800 in layer-2 semantic-mapping and mode-mapping. Hex #373239. Estimated Lc 68 — passes ui-label threshold (Lc 60). Re-audit required to confirm and set verified=true.

on-primary-on-primary-fill.resolution: Within warn-threshold (3 Lc). Acceptable for ui-label use-class (Lc 60). Fails body use-class (Lc 75). Do not use on-primary for body text on primary fill.

on-secondary-on-secondary-fill.resolution: Acceptable for ui-label. Do not use on-secondary for body text on secondary fill.

success-fill-on-white.resolution: Stop moved from 500 to 600. True-green family risk=medium. Stop 500 fails Lc 60 on white. Stop 600 passes ui-label on white and body text threshold for on-success.

dark-mode-elevation-collapsed.issue: background and surface both mapped to {pg.1000} — elevation levels ignored
dark-mode-elevation-collapsed.resolution: Dark-mode elevation computed from ΔL deltas per layer-2 dark-mode-elevation spec. surface={elev.1}, surface-elevated={elev.2}. Elevation tokens added to primitive-token-naming.

apca-extensions-audit-policy.invalidation-rule: Any change to a token $value sets verified=false on that token. Build will fail at apca-extensions-policy gate until audit tool re-runs.

audit-tool-requirement.input: Resolved hex pairs — both sRGB and P3 for dual-variant tokens
audit-tool-requirement.output: Writes $extensions block directly to token JSON
audit-tool-requirement.must-not: Must not allow hand-editing of verified, lc, or status fields

apca-extensions-audit-policy.warn-threshold-note: Emit build warning if lc is within 3 Lc of lc-target. A stop change could silently push it below threshold.
apca-extensions-audit-policy.relationship-to-correction-policy: apca-delta-correction-policy governs how state tokens are corrected after failing. This policy governs how all tokens are audited and gated before correction is considered. Audit always runs first.

state-separation-validation.distance-formula-note: Practical approximation suitable for token comparison. NOT equivalent to ΔE_OKLCH (Björn Ottosson's formal perceptual metric). Consistent implementation is more important than switching to the formal metric.

token-scale-policy.current-estimate: 8 roles × 7 states + 6 focus-ring tokens × 3 gamuts = ~192 base. With reduced-motion: ~384.
token-scale-policy.build-report-requirement: If count >= 200, build report MUST include migration-guidance section, not just a warning.

role-modifier-migration.figma-pattern: Mode per interaction state on single variable. 8 modes × 1 variable = same count, far more manageable.
role-modifier-migration.figma-limitation: Modes cannot nest — requires compound modes (light-default, light-hover, dark-default, dark-hover).
role-modifier-migration.recommendation: Stay with flat tokens until threshold. Migrate CSS first. Figma Variables last.

interaction-physics.description: Single source of truth for all interaction delta values and the lightness pivot threshold. All layer-4 component tokens reference this block — they must never hardcode these values directly.
interaction-physics.pivot-note: Surfaces with L < threshold are treated as dark fills (lighten on hover). Surfaces with L >= threshold are treated as light containers (darken on hover). Change this one value to shift the pivot point system-wide.

hover-deltas.note: lighten applied when source L < pivot-threshold. darken applied when source L >= pivot-threshold.

interaction-physics.compiler-instruction: When resolving a layer-4 delta reference, read the pointer path (e.g. {layer-3.interaction-physics.hover-deltas}), look up this block, then compute the resolved colour. Never inline these values into layer-4.

subtle-press-delta.note: Small press delta for low-emphasis components (menu items, list items, ghost active). Below the full active-delta magnitude to avoid visual jarring on subtle fills.

ghost-active-delta.note: Ghost button active — stronger than subtle-press but not full active-delta since ghost has no fill to start with.

achromatic-snap-rule.description: Hue angle is mathematically undefined at C=0 and numerically unstable below C=0.01. Delta application on near-neutral tokens produces hue jitter — a cool grey hover state can snap to dirty yellow because the direction of ΔC is arbitrary at near-zero chroma.
achromatic-snap-rule.rule: If base token C < 0.01: apply ΔL only. Force C=0 and H=0 in output. Never apply ΔC to near-neutral tokens.
achromatic-snap-rule.why: At very low chroma, floating-point hue computation produces arbitrary angles. A ΔC of +0.02 on C=0.005 resolves to an undefined hue direction.
achromatic-snap-rule.compiler-instruction: In resolve_interaction_state: if C < achromatic-snap-rule.threshold-C, return gamut_safe_oklch_to_hex(new_L, 0.0, 0.0). Skip all ΔC and ΔH application.

fill-border-distinctness-policy.description: Governs the relationship between fill and border tokens sharing the same semantic colour. A border token that resolves to the same hex as its sibling fill token is invisible when drawn around or inside that fill. This policy makes the distinctness constraint explicit and machine-checkable.
fill-border-distinctness-policy.rule: For every semantic colour, color/border/{sem} MUST resolve to a different hex than color/fill/{sem} in every compiled mode.

stop-convention.description: Border stop is chosen to be visually distinct from the fill stop while remaining in the same hue family. The exact stop is set in Layer 4 and may differ between light and dark modes.
stop-convention.light-mode-pattern: border stop = fill stop + 1 (darker, more emphasis)
stop-convention.dark-mode-pattern: border stop = fill stop + 1 (darker/deeper against pale fills)

compiler-enforcement.when: After resolving all semantic roles to hex, before emitting any output
compiler-enforcement.check: For each sibling pair, assert fill-hex != border-hex in every mode
compiler-enforcement.on-violation: HARD BUILD ERROR — not a warning. Output is structurally incorrect.
compiler-enforcement.error-message: FILL_BORDER_CONFLICT: color/border/{sem} resolves to {hex} in {mode} mode, which is identical to color/fill/{sem}. Border is invisible against its fill. Shift the border stop in Layer 4 semantic-role-map.

fill-border-distinctness-policy.root-cause-note: This bug arises when border stops are copied from fill stops during Layer 4 authoring without checking distinctness. The light-mode conflicts were caught visually in Figma. Dark-mode conflicts (all four semantic colours at stop 300) were caught by this policy check during compiler development.

muddy-zone-definition.description: Hue+lightness+chroma coordinates that produce instinctively unappealing results. Primarily the dark-yellow/olive/muddy-brown region. Occurs when warm-floor surfaces receive linear ΔL interaction deltas that drift into this zone.
muddy-zone-definition.compiler-action: Emit WARNING when an interaction state delta produces a token in this zone. Do not hard-error — editorial use may be intentional.
muddy-zone-definition.most-at-risk: pg-ramp (warm orange tint) + hover state on elev.1 or elev.2 surfaces.
muddy-zone-definition.reference: pro-color-harmonies avoidMuddyZones utility. Peter Donahue UFV paint mixing lecture: 'black + yellow = olive'.
muddy-zone-definition.mitigation: Reduce ΔC on warming deltas for yellow/orange families, or add a −5° hue correction to move out of the zone.

cvd-guardrail-policy.description: Colour vision deficiency (CVD) simulation check. Verifies semantic fill pairs remain perceptually distinct under deuteranopia and protanopia simulation. Deuteranopia + protanopia combined affect approximately 8% of males.
cvd-guardrail-policy.scope: Semantic fill pairs that encode distinct meaning: success/error, success/warning.
cvd-guardrail-policy.simulation-method: Vienot et al. 1999 approximation matrices in linear sRGB space.

deuteranopia.description: No M-cone (red-green blindness, most common). Vienot 1999 approximation.

threshold.metric: OKLAB ΔE between simulated colour pair
threshold.interpretation: ΔE < 0.10 = states effectively indistinguishable. Hue alone is insufficient — lightness separation or iconography required.

cvd-guardrail-policy.severity: WARNING by default. HARD ERROR in --strict mode.

interaction-state-extension.description: Extend CVD check to interaction state deltas (concern #29). A hover state change that is visually distinct for normal vision may fall on a CVD confusion line and be invisible.
interaction-state-extension.check: ΔE in simulated space between base token and hover token must exceed JND threshold (~3) for all CVD types.
interaction-state-extension.status: Documented for future implementation. Current check covers static semantic role pairs.

cvd-guardrail-policy.compiler-enforcement: STEP 9c. Runs after fill-border check, before APCA audit.

vibration-guardrail-policy.description: Chromostereopsis check. High-chroma complementary pairs cause eye-depth conflict — the eye cannot focus both wavelengths at the same retinal depth simultaneously. Adjacent placement produces a painful vibrating effect.
vibration-guardrail-policy.scientific-basis: Chromostereopsis. Lens focuses different wavelengths at slightly different depths on the retina. Red advances visually; blue recedes. At high saturation with hue separation > 150°, this conflict becomes physically distressing.
vibration-guardrail-policy.severity: WARNING. Hard warning if pair appears on interactive/scrollable components.
vibration-guardrail-policy.compiler-enforcement: STEP 9e. Checks all color/fill/* pairs per mode.
vibration-guardrail-policy.mitigation: Reduce chroma of one member of the pair below 0.15, or ensure they are never placed adjacent in layout.

surface-chroma-cap-policy.description: Prevents surface/background/subtle tokens from appearing self-luminous (emissive) rather than reflective. High chroma at mid-lightness creates a glowing appearance that breaks the material metaphor used by design systems.
surface-chroma-cap-policy.scientific-basis: Grum fluorence boundary / CIECAM02 brightness vs lightness distinction. Colours above C=0.08 at mid-lightness can cross into emissive appearance territory — they look like they emit light rather than reflect it.
surface-chroma-cap-policy.compiler-enforcement: STEP 9f. Checks all resolved semantic tokens whose role name contains bg, surface, or subtle.

changelog.1.5: Added achromatic-snap-rule (concern #27), muddy-zone-definition (#21), cvd-guardrail-policy (#1+#29), vibration-guardrail-policy (#26), surface-chroma-cap-policy (#31).
